en.title: Shortest Total Time Flying a Ring in Request Order
en.description:
m stations form a two-way ring, and the edge lengths give the flight time between adjacent stations. The drone starts at station 1 and must reach all requested stations in order; find the minimum total time. A repeated visit to the same station requires no movement.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains m q, the second line contains m edge lengths, and the third line contains q 1-based requested stations. 1≤m,q≤100000, edge lengths 1..10^9.
en.explanation: Example 1: 1→1 costs 0, 1→3 costs 1, 3→3 costs 0, and 3→2 costs 2, for a total of 3. Example 2: costs 5, 3 and 6, for a total of 14. Example 3: the drone always stays at the only station, so the answer is 0.
hints: Prefix sums give the distance d along the forward unrolling; choose min(d,(total perimeter)−d) for each leg and update the current station.
